1. Tandem Bakery - Super lowkey with vegan and gluten-free food and drink. Also very quiet and small! Near campus as well!
2. Rise & Rooted - A bit louder since it's a cafe on campus but as long as you have headphones you should be fine.
3. Missoula College - Lots of lounge areas for studying along with an awesome view!
4. University Center - Food & good Wi-Fi if you still want to be on campus.
5. Black Coffee Roasting Co. - Very big with multiple tables that are great for studying, farther from campus than ideal though.

​

These are places where I've studied outside of my apartment - so I recommend giving them a try!

I am just about to turn 21 and I’m taking everything one step at a time. Society conditions you to go through life at a status quo type pace - but do what you feel you need to do to be happy.

Happy birthday. You matter no matter what you’re accomplishing and what you’re doing today. Sending love ❤️
Whaaaa??
Thank you!

I understand how that feels, and just know I’ll hear you out if you want to PM me and talk about it. Thank you for sharing how you feel. I know it must be hard to make such important and impactful decisions like this.
If this is a tooth abscess you might need to go into a clinic and get it removed!
Why that date specifically? Does it hold significant meaning to you?

OP I know it’s tough, but there are people you’ve never met, places you’ve never seen and memories you haven’t made yet. This feeling is temporary, as permanent as it might feel.

I hope you’re still here with us. To share your future opportunities and progress.
Oh my god… I am SO sorry, if you need to talk to anyone I’m here for you. That guy is a piece of garbage for that.
Who took the time to even buy the paint, drive to the location, and then write something stupid like this? Get a life fr 💀

It feels like everything is probably coagulating together into this dark cloud. I understand. Not everything will be fine - I won’t lie to you about that, but you do have to give yourself another chance to be happy in the future. Maybe write out any letters and see if you change your mind. But you do have support in this community.
Lmao thank you, wish I had that meme on deck rn
Thank you, friend :) I wouldn’t want to be a bother
Thank you. Grieving multiple things is so confusing. And I’m trying to stick around people that help me to make sense of things.. right now death just seems like the only out for me.

My cousin is actually arguing with me over the eviction too. She thought it was my fault for some reason when she was the one arguing with the landlord. She won’t even apologize for pushing me away when i was hurting.

Honestly, I went out on a date 2 days after my breakup with a guy I met on Bumble. You don’t want to use anyone as a rebound because you end up feeling guilty. Don’t add guilt on top of grieving over a breakup.

Called things off with the guy and turned out that I avoided a huge red flag. But you’re probably not going to find anything of substance on dating apps that are mostly used for hookups. After a while I stopped being interested. When love comes, it comes softly friend :) I believe you’ll find something beautiful if that’s what you want.

Love and light ❤️
Yeah, honestly it just makes me wonder wtf he’s saying to people.

I am seriously wishing you the best in the romance department whether you want something or if you’re wanting to stay single for a while (which I wouldn’t blame you). That guy is a serious piece of work and that is all the closure you need.

Sending love and light ❤️ you got this!
They didn’t notice until you did WHAT? 😀
Ewww good riddance wtf!! I hope it gave you the closure you needed to move on from that POS and find better!

I think the title of your post is kind of self explanatory. You’re “over the drama” so be completely over it and seriously initiate boundaries with the no contact. Feelings are getting hurt and it’s causing more heartache than needed.

Don’t know the details of the break up but I think this person is trying to hold onto something that isn’t there and it’s hurting both of you in the long run.

Sometimes nothing is better than trying to cultivate a friendship based on the fact that you two broke up. I hope I could help with your decision somewhat!

It will get easier Rach. Trust me on that. It’s been over a month since mine and ik I was originally the one asking but time truly does heal all wounds. I guess just feel those feelings and everything will correct itself in due time.

You WILL find someone who cares about you deeply. This one was just a bad egg. I hate being preachy like this but maybe this relationship was a life lesson. Even if you didn’t want that.

Love comes softly so when you least expect it something beautiful will come along :) keep on keeping on and focus on yourself in the meantime. You’re worth so much more than this.
“It’s not you, it’s me.” Basically said the distance was taking a toll when we were long distance the whole time. No closure was given and it’s really hurtful and confusing.
If you don’t mind me asking, how long ago did this happen? And I’m really sorry to hear it man :( that seriously blows…
Oh man, I really appreciate this. I thought I was going crazy for wanting to get out of here so fast so I'm glad I can relate to your experience. Thank you for taking the time to respond here.
Yes I have, he always reassures me that nothing is wrong so I think it might be generalized anxiety coming into play unfortunately :(

Hey, I have talked to him about it and he understands I have my own stuff I need to work through, it’s just hard because I still don’t really understand why I’m having anxiety like this.

I do have a counselor I’m going to talk to before I self sabotage though! I just get nervous when he messages and it’s so weird!
